scientific_integrity.priority_claim: Qualified, not absolute; no formal independent literature certification.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Complete semigroup-theoretic argument with elementary intrinsic-idempotent and Green-relation reductions; finite tests corroborate.

scientific_limitations: Group classification concerns matrix-unit Brandt semigroups, with at least two indices; other Rees or group-labeled Brandt semigroups are not addressed.
The exact orbit formula and asymptotic require finite index sets.
Tamura (1986) is a highly relevant historical isomorphism source but full-text comparison was inaccessible; historical priority requires independent verification.
title: Rigidity and orbit growth for power semigroups of finite matrix units
